title: Back with Carey at the Winter Garden
summary: Lee returns to Jack Carey's band at the Winter Garden, where the best musicians sat in.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Upstairs. Upstairs. There's a Pythian temple they call it sometime I think.

I go to work with Jack Kerrie and say, see y'all just quit too early. We went to my place where we used to go, we called Eagle Saloon. We were running by Ben Dale at that time. Ben Mulligan I meant to say. Say, I'm going to work now at the Winter Garden. And so I gets back with Jack Kerrie band and get Edmund Hall. We go back to Jack Kerrie and start playing. So I had quite a ball around the Winter Garden. All the best class musicians to come and sit in. Lorenzo Teal, Buddy Petit was the king, best young corner player then in New Orleans. Because Bunk had been going out and went to the country at that time. You're a place called New Iberia.
